description:
About the Role

Lead OpenAI’s field delivery of civil works, structures, building envelope, architectural fit-out and landscape interfaces, from site preparation through completed facilities.

You will be OpenAI’s accountable on-site lead for civil, structural, landscape and architectural construction, directing and overseeing the work of general contractors, specialist contractors and other service providers within your discipline. You will combine practical subject-matter depth with hands-on field leadership, managing contracted support to deliver safe, high-quality work to the integrated construction plan.

Reporting and scope

Report to the Site Construction Manager, who reports through the applicable project-management leadership. Coordinate design interpretation and technical decisions with the responsible civil, structural and architectural engineers.

Own day-to-day discipline execution and contractor performance within the assigned site scope and delegated authority. Coordinate priorities and interfaces through the Site Construction Manager; escalate material cost, schedule, design and acceptance decisions to the appropriate owners.

This is a senior site delivery role, suited to an experienced superintendent, supervisor, manager or trade lead. Accountability is for an assigned discipline and site work packages. Site assignment, duration and any shared coverage follow project phase, workload and the staffing plan; effective on-site coverage is required during critical activities.

Key Responsibilities

 - Direct and coordinate general contractors, civil and structural trades, architectural contractors and specialist service providers against the approved design, construction schedule and quality requirements.

 - Oversee earthworks, grading, drainage, underground interfaces, foundations, concrete, structural steel, building envelope and architectural completion; coordinate landscape and external works.

 - Review constructability, work sequencing, contractor work plans, RFIs, submittals and proposed changes; obtain design decisions from the responsible engineers and track field implementation.

 - Coordinate building and underground interfaces with mechanical, electrical and network leads and hardware deployment teams, protecting access, equipment routes and installation readiness.

 - Inspect work with quality teams, track nonconformances and punch lists, and verify contractor closeout, as-built records and turnover readiness.

 - Set clear contractor deliverables and work priorities; review staffing, progress and quality, identify constraints early, and drive recovery actions through the Site Construction Manager.

 - Provide concise progress and risk reporting, evaluate field impacts of proposed changes, and maintain accountable handoffs between construction partners and OpenAI teams.

Qualifications

 - Typically 8–10 years of civil, structural or architectural construction experience, including substantial data center or comparable complex industrial site delivery and responsibility for contractors or multiple work packages. Equivalent depth of practical delivery experience will be considered.

 - Ability to read and coordinate civil, structural and architectural drawings, specifications, surveys and relevant geotechnical information, recognizing impacts on grading, drainage, earthworks, foundations, underground services and building construction.

 - Experience translating approved designs into buildable field packages, sequencing, temporary-work interfaces and inspection hold points; assess utility conflicts, equipment access and phased handover before releasing work.

 - Experience reviewing RFIs, submittals and field changes, coordinating design decisions with the engineer of record, and verifying approved changes in the field while preserving clear design responsibility.

 - Practical knowledge of inspection and acceptance evidence for civil works, concrete, steel, building envelope and architectural completion, including nonconformance resolution, punch lists and as-built records.

 - Ability to coordinate construction with permitting conditions, environmental constraints and authorities having jurisdiction through the responsible engineering and EHS teams.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead contractors and service providers through changing site conditions, set clear deliverables and acceptance criteria, and resolve performance gaps across organizations without relying on direct reporting authority.

 - Strong written and verbal communication: maintain accurate field records, action and decision logs, and explain technical risks, schedule impacts and recovery options to site leadership, engineers and delivery partners.

 - Sound judgment when information is incomplete: identify assumptions, prerequisites and interfaces, determine what work can proceed within approved authority, and escalate unresolved risks before they affect safety, quality or delivery.

 - Relevant trade, apprenticeship, technical or degree-based preparation, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated field leadership and subject-matter competence are central to this site role.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing
description:
ABOUT QUINCE
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
OUR CULTURE
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.
If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
THE ROLE
Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing
We are seeking a  Senior Data Analyst, Growth Marketing to join our growing team. This role sits at the center of how Quince decides where to invest to acquire customers. You will own marketing analytics across growth channels and build the measurement frameworks, including attribution, incrementality, and channel performance, that show what is driving acquisition and where to invest next. You will partner closely with marketing leadership to surface insights, run experiments, and build scalable analytics tools as the team expands. Over time, you will become the go-to expert on growth data across the Quince platform.
In this role, you will help the team make faster, smarter investment decisions by turning channel data into clear, trusted answers about what is working and where to put the next dollar.
Responsibilities
Own marketing attribution modeling and measurement frameworks across growth channels (search, social, etc.)

Advanced Packaging Implementations: Design and develop advanced IC packaging solutions, including flip-chip BGA (FCBGA), System-in-Package (SiP), and 2.5D/3D IC architectures (e.g., interposers, CoWoS, EMIB, FOWLP). Manufacturing Collateral: Generate and validate complete manufacturing collateral (Gerbers, ODB++, BOMs) for tapeout and manufacturing release. Vendor & OSAT Integration: Interface with foundries, substrate vendors, and OSAT partners to evaluate design feasibility, select packaging materials and design rules, maximize manufacturing yield, and execute smooth tapeouts. Join Our Team as a Mechanical Engineer II !
Are you passionate about  Technology Breakthrough and Innovation?  S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to join our Technology Breakthrough and Innovation team. As a Mechanical Engineer II,  you’ll be crucial in ensuring continued innovation and supporting our diverse team.
The Mechanical Engineer II assists in the development of new and sustaining products by designing, prototyping, testing and documentation.  They contribute to product development, supplier engagement and cross-functional collaboration, and begin to take initiative in supporting projects and solving problems.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Support: Execute mechanical engineering tasks such as tolerance analysis and full cycle component design.  Execute projects and tasks with moderate independence, with some oversight from senior-level engineers, applying sound mechanical judgement and problem-solving skills.  Support root cause analysis, troubleshoot production problems, and assist in RMA analysis.
Simulation & Technical Analysis: Perform engineering calculations and simulations, including dynamic and current flow analyses to support design decisions and performance.
Design & Documentation: Create mechanical designs from concept to production using CAD tools.  Ensure accuracy and completeness of engineering schematics and documentation.  Working knowledge of GD&T principles and their application to engineering drawings.
Supplier Collaboration: Engage with suppliers to support component development and troubleshooting.  Participate in technical discussions to resolve issues related to part quality, performance, or manufacturability.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with project managers and other engineering disciplines and contribute to project planning and documentation efforts.
Research & Technology: Conduct mechanical testing, analyze results, compile findings into a formal report, and present data-driven insights to the mechanical engineering team.
New Product Design : Support the creation of new products by developing mechanical concepts and refining designs for performance, cost and manufacturability.  Assist in prototyping development, design validation and participate in design reviews and cross-functional teams.
Continuous Improvement: Learn product functionality and capabilities through hands-on experience and mentorship from senior-level engineers.
Compliance: Understand and comply with all applicable company policies and rules.
What you’ll Need to Succeed:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
2-4 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, Strong Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Good proficiency in CAD and/or similar tools.
Good understanding of engineering software for modeling and simulation.
Good skills in effective problem-solving and able to communicate across some levels of the organization related to concepts of supply-chain, production, and electronics.
An understanding of various manufacturing technologies and methods, preferably within the electronics manufacturing industry.
Strong interpersonal skills to establish meaningful relationships built on mutual trust and respect, and foster collaborative working relationships amongst a diverse audience.
Great communication skills (written, verbal, listening and presentation), able to partner with and communicate with customers both technical and non-technical.
Commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the quality function.
Effective organizational planning skills, coordinating internal and external resources, and the ability to balance critical priorities.
Sound business sense and analytical skills with the ability to use and analyze data to drive inform actions, solve complex problems and drive learning.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines, including the flexibility to work extended hours when necessary.
Great computer skills and ability to use Microsoft Office Applications, specifically  MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project and Power Bi or other similar systems paired with strong data analysis skills.

title: (New Grad) Account Development Representative II - Atlanta
description:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
The Account Development Representative (ADR) job is the launching point for an individual looking for a successful career in SaaS sales. In this role, you will be at the front of Samsara’s go-to-market strategy. This includes hunting for leads, mapping enterprise accounts, and building demand for Samsara’s full line of products. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop enterprise technology sales skills and to advance their careers. Successful ADRs earn accelerated commissions and head down the path for promotion into closing roles. You will work closely with top-tier executives and will see up close how sales organizations succeed.
This is a hybrid position open to candidates residing in Atlanta, Georgia, requiring 3 days per week onsite and 2 days remote.
You should apply if :
You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career : If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
You love talking to people : In this role you will average 50 calls to prospective customers daily.
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
You treat rejection as a learning experience : In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
You want to be with the best : Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Minimum requirements for this role :
Ability and willingness to make 50 cold calls a day.
At least 6 months of sales experience and/or sales prospecting ability. This can be sales related coursework, sales competitions, etc.
Must be currently enrolled in an accredited 4-year Bachelor's degree program or within 1 year of graduation
An ideal candidate has :
Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
6 Months experience with Salesforce, LI Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo.
Ability to quickly grasp technical concepts and embed AI usage into day to day operations
#LI-Hybrid
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual OTE Salary $54,621 — $73,440 USD Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here .

About Stripe

Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy.
The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Our work spans mobile user experience, reusable SDK architecture, camera and document-capture experiences, developer experience, security, accessibility, reliability, and integration with Stripe’s backend systems.
Why Stripe Identity?
Build mobile experiences that help establish trust between businesses and their users.
Solve challenging product and technical problems involving mobile platforms, sensitive data, fraud prevention, and global scale.
Create SDKs used by developers across industries, including fintech, marketplaces, and online platforms.
Help shape the future of digital identity and make verification easier, safer, and more accessible.
Our vision is to build the world’s most trusted store of verified identities, enabling frictionless identity verification across Stripe and beyond.
We’re looking for engineers who care deeply about mobile craft and the entire user journey. You should enjoy translating complex technical and regulatory requirements into simple, polished experiences; working through ambiguity; and learning new technologies and systems.
Join us to build mobile identity-verification experiences that businesses can integrate easily and that their users can trust.
What you’ll do
Responsibilities
As an Android engineer on the Identity team, you will:
Design, build, and maintain Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs and verification experiences across iOS, Android, and React Native.
Create intuitive, polished experiences for complex flows such as identity-document and selfie capture, while accounting for accessibility, device capabilities, and varied real-world conditions.
Build reliable and extensible SDK APIs and reusable components that make it easy for developers to integrate Stripe Identity into their applications.
Work across mobile clients, supporting APIs, and services to deliver features end to end rather than treating the mobile application as an isolated layer.
Improve SDK performance, reliability, observability, testing, release processes, and backward compatibility.
Make thoughtful architectural decisions that balance user experience, developer experience, security, privacy, and long-term maintainability.
Partner closely with product managers, designers, machine-learning engineers, backend engineers, user researchers, and other mobile teams.
Work with Stripe users and field teams to understand integration challenges and turn their feedback into product and platform improvements.
Help establish and evolve mobile-engineering practices across Identity and Stripe.
Operate and maintain the systems and SDKs the team owns, including diagnosing production issues and improving them based on what we learn.
Who you are
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
3+ years of professional software-development experience, including meaningful experience building and shipping mobile applications or SDKs.
Experience developing for at least one major mobile platform using technologies such as Kotlin or Java for Android.
Strong software-design fundamentals and experience creating maintainable APIs, components, or frameworks.
Experience delivering mobile functionality beyond an isolated UI layer for example, integrating with APIs and services, handling local state, or working with device capabilities.
Experience testing, debugging, monitoring, and improving mobile software in production.
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, design, and other technical and non-technical partners.
A demonstrated commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
Preferred qualifications
Experience building mobile SDKs, shared libraries, or developer-facing APIs used outside your immediate team.
Experience with both iOS and Android, or with cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Kotlin Multiplatform.
Experience with camera, image-processing, document-capture, biometrics, or other device-integrated mobile experiences.
Experience designing mobile software that handles sensitive data and applies security and privacy principles by default.
Familiarity with accessibility, internationalization, mobile performance, and unreliable network conditions.
Experience with mobile CI, automated testing, release automation, observability, or developer-productivity tooling.
Experience contributing to backend APIs or services that support mobile products.
Ability to simplify complex requirements and favor durable, scalable solutions.
Comfort reasoning clearly and moving with urgency in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
Familiarity with Stripe’s products, ideally through integrating Stripe APIs or SDKs into another application.

title: Director of IT & Infrastructure
description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks.
As Director of IT & Infrastructure , you’ll lead the team, systems, and infrastructure that keep our employees connected and our operations moving. Your scope will span global IT support, enterprise applications, identity and access, corporate networks, and the setup of facilities for new transit service launches.
This role combines excellent people leadership with hands-on technical expertise. Balancing an entrepreneurial spirit with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, you will serve as a key stakeholder in building the reliable services our teams and partners depend on. From improving employee support through automation and AI to getting a new operational site ready for launch, you’ll turn complex requirements into well-run systems and repeatable processes.
What You’ll Do:
Lead our global IT team. Develop and support the team, establish clear ownership and service expectations, and translate business priorities into an actionable IT roadmap. Balance daily operations with infrastructure improvements and longer-term projects.
Own the employee IT experience. Oversee support across offices, remote teams, and operational sites. Lead the administration and continuous improvement of Freshservice , including ticketing, the service catalog, approvals, inventory, knowledge management, and automated workflows.
Manage identity and access. Oversee Okta , SSO, application provisioning, and employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding. Maintain reliable access approval and provisioning workflows between Freshservice, Okta, and connected applications.
Run dependable infrastructure. Oversee corporate networks, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, remote access, and IT-managed infrastructure. Use platforms such as Cisco Meraki to monitor sites, address outages, and improve reliability. Manage relevant DNS, domain, and certificate requirements, including work with Cloudflare, AWS, GCP .
Deliver Network TaaS launch readiness. Own facility setup and IT readiness for new launches, from sourcing telecommunications providers and infrastructure contractors to overseeing onsite installations, security cameras, and physical access control systems. Ensure access to company applications reflects each launch’s staffing and operational requirements.
Manage the endpoint and asset lifecycle. Establish hardware standards and oversee device deployment, management, support, inventory, purchasing, logistics, replacement, and secure disposal for a
Keep enterprise applications working together. Oversee platforms including Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, and Confluence, Freshservice, Iru and more , and partner with business owners on departmental systems. Lead implementations, migrations, and consolidation projects with clear support and administrative ownership.
Build better workflows through automation and AI. Expand integrations across Freshservice, Okta, Slack, Confluence, and other services. Develop and maintain bots and AI agents that answer employee questions, use company knowledge, and handle service requests, with appropriate monitoring and controls.
Support practical AI adoption. Manage the rollout and administration of tools such as Claude and Cursor , including employee access, licensing, usage allocations, spending visibility, and support.
Manage technology spending and suppliers. Own IT budget planning and tracking, vendor relationships, commercial negotiations, renewals, and license optimization. Lead technical assessments within ZIP procurement workflows alongside Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Information Security.
Strengthen security and operational continuity. Partner with Information Security to implement controls across IT-managed systems, support audits and access reviews, and address control gaps. Maintain recovery procedures, system documentation, and backup ownership for critical services.
Who You Are:
An experienced IT leader with 10+ years in corporate IT or infrastructure , including 4+ years managing teams , ideally in a global technology company.
A hands-on technical leader who can move comfortably between coaching a team, planning a deployment, troubleshooting an integration, and managing a vendor escalation.
Experienced in identity and access management, SaaS administration, endpoint management, networking, and IT service delivery. Familiarity with Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco Meraki, and Freshservice , or comparable platforms, will help you succeed.
Comfortable delivering technology infrastructure for new offices or operational sites, including coordinating connectivity providers, contractors, and installation schedules.
Skilled at improving processes through APIs, integrations, and automation, with practical experience applying AI to internal support or employee workflows.
Commercially minded, with experience managing budgets, negotiating with suppliers, and improving software and hardware spending.
A clear communicator who builds strong working relationships across Operations, Engineering, Information Security, People, Finance, and other business teams.
Organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-moving environment. You follow problems through to resolution and build processes that help prevent them from recurring.

title: Field Merchandiser
description:
Job Family Group:
Retail Group
Job Description:
The Field Merchandiser is responsible for the hands-on execution of merchandising initiatives across TA locations. This position works as part of a traveling field team responsible for completing store resets, reflows, cooler resets and refreshes, remodel support, fixture changes, planogram implementation, promotional execution, backroom and storage organization, and other merchandising projects.
The Field Merchandiser may also assist with the reflow and remerchandising of deli and sales desk areas to improve product presentation, space utilization, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
This is a highly physical, hands-on role requiring frequent travel and the ability to work effectively in an active retail environment. Field Merchandisers will be expected to move merchandise, tear down and rebuild fixtures, stock and organize product, install merchandising materials, and ensure stores are completed according to approved layouts, planograms, merchandising standards, and BP safety requirements.
This role is 50 hours per week.
Key Responsibilities
Safety
Follow all BP and TA safety policies, procedures, and protocols at all times .
Complete required safety training and utilize required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Maintain a safe work environment for team members, store employees, customers, and vendors throughout each project.
Follow proper lifting, material-handling, ladder, equipment, cooler, and fixture-installation procedures.
Immediately identify and report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment, injuries, or other safety concerns.
Maintain clean and organized work areas during resets and leave stores safe and customer-ready at the completion of each workday.
Store Resets & Fixture Installation
Participate in complete and partial store resets, reflows, remodels, and merchandising refreshes.
Tear down, move, assemble, rebuild, level, and position retail fixtures and shelving according to approved store layouts.
Remove and reinstall shelves, peg hooks, displays, racks, endcaps, merchandising accessories, and other store fixtures.
Safely move product and fixtures throughout the store as required to complete resets.
Assist with receiving, staging, organizing, and installing new fixtures and merchandising materials.
Identify damaged or missing fixtures, components, or supplies and communicate issues quickly to the appropriate project leader.
Cooler Resets & Refreshes
Complete cooler resets, reflows, and merchandising refreshes according to approved layouts and planograms.
Remove, stage, organize, and replace refrigerated merchandise as necessary to complete cooler resets.
Adjust shelves, product placement, facings, and merchandising organization within coolers according to approved plans.
Assist with reorganizing cooler space to improve product presentation, shopability, inventory capacity, and replenishment.
Identify damaged shelving, fixtures, tags, signage, or other cooler-related merchandising issues and communicate them to project leadership.
Coordinate cooler work with store management to minimize product exposure and disruption to normal store operations.
Planogram & Layout Execution
Read, understand, and accurately execute approved store layouts, floor plans, planograms, cooler layouts, and merchandising instructions .
Set shelves, fixtures, products, and displays to the specifications provided.
Ensure correct product placement, facings, shelf heights, spacing, sequencing, and merchandising presentation.
Validate that completed sections match approved planograms and layouts.
Identify situations where store conditions prevent proper execution and call out those issues rather than making unauthorized changes.
Support field validation of new layouts and planograms and provide feedback when execution challenges are identified.
Backroom, Storage & Cooler Organization
Assist with the organization and improvement of backrooms, storage areas, coolers, and other inventory holding areas as part of store reset and reflow projects.
Organize inventory to improve accessibility, replenishment, inventory visibility, and overall store efficiency.
Help identify excess, obsolete, discontinued, damaged, or misplaced merchandise and follow established procedures for disposition.
Organize merchandising supplies, fixtures, shelving, signage, and other materials to improve store-level execution.
Help establish sustainable organization standards that store teams can maintain after the Field Merchandising team leaves.
Ensure backroom, storage, and cooler areas are left clean, organized, safe, and operationally functional.
Deli & Sales Desk Reflow Support
Assist with the reflow, reorganization, and remerchandising of deli and sales desk areas as directed by approved project plans.
Move and reposition merchandise, displays, shelving, racks, and other approved fixtures to support revised layouts.
Assist with improving product placement, customer flow, visibility, impulse merchandising, and overall presentation in these areas.
Support the merchandising of food, beverage, grab-and-go, impulse, and other approved products associated with deli and sales desk areas.
Install appropriate signage, shelf tags, promotional materials, and merchandising communication.
Work closely with store teams and appropriate functional partners to minimize disruption to deli, sales desk, and customer operations.
Product Merchandising
Remove product from existing fixtures and properly stage merchandise during resets.
Restock and merchandise products following completion of fixture, cooler, and Planogram work.
Identify discontinued, damaged, excess, misplaced, or non-planogrammed inventory and follow established procedures for disposition.
Ensure merchandise is properly faced, organized, priced, and presented before completing a project.
Install shelf tags, price labels, promotional signage, displays, endcap materials, and other merchandising communication.
Help ensure promotional and seasonal programs are implemented according to established standards.
Store & Team Support
Work collaboratively with store management and team members while minimizing disruption to customers and normal store operations.
Communicate project progress, execution issues, missing materials, inventory concerns, and other barriers to Field Merchandising leadership.
Assist store teams in understanding new layouts, cooler sets, merchandising standards, organization expectations, and other changes following a reset.
Maintain a professional attitude and represent BP/TA appropriately when interacting with store employees, customers, vendors, and other partners.
Support other field merchandising and retail execution initiatives as business needs require.
Physical Requirements
This position requires significant physical activity. Team members must be able to:
Regularly lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise, fixtures, shelving, equipment, and supplies.
Lift and move heavy objects, including items weighing up to 50 pounds independently , and heavier items with appropriate assistance or equipment.
Bend, kneel, squat, reach, climb, and work at varying heights throughout the workday.
Safely use ladders and approved material-handling equipment when required.
Stand and walk for extended periods, including the majority of a work shift.
Perform repetitive lifting, stocking, fixture assembly, cooler resets, and merchandising activities.
Work for reasonable periods in refrigerated cooler environments when completing cooler resets or organization.
Work safely in active retail environments that may include customers, deliveries, contractors, and ongoing store operations.
Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law.
Travel & Scheduling Requirements
Frequent travel is required , including weekly and overnight travel.
Must be able to travel by automobile and commercial airline as business needs require.
Must be able to work at TA locations throughout the United States.
Must maintain scheduling flexibility based on project and store requirements.
Work schedules may include early mornings, evenings, overnight work, and occasional weekends depending on project needs.
Team members are expected to coordinate travel with other Field Merchandising team members when appropriate to improve efficiency and control travel costs.
Qualifications
Previous retail, merchandising, store operations, construction/fixture installation, warehouse, or related experience preferred.
Experience completing retail resets or working from planograms and store layouts strongly preferred.
Experience with cooler resets, inventory organization, or convenience/travel center merchandising is a plus.
Ability to read and accurately follow detailed instructions, layouts, diagrams, and planograms.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to execution standards.
Ability to perform physically demanding work safely and consistently.
Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a traveling team.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to adapt quickly when field conditions differ from plans while escalating decisions appropriately.
Valid driver's license and ability to meet applicable company travel requirements.
Measures of Success
Success in the Field Merchandiser role will be measured by:
Safety – Work is completed without compromising BP/TA safety standards.
Accuracy – Store layouts, cooler layouts, and planograms are executed correctly.
Quality – Fixtures, merchandise, pricing, signage, coolers, backrooms, and storage areas meet established standards.
Productivity – Projects are completed efficiently and within established timelines.
Consistency – Execution standards are maintained from location to location.
Organization – Backrooms, storage areas, coolers, and merchandising supplies are left organized and easier for store teams to manage.
Teamwork – Works effectively with fellow Field Merchandisers, store teams, and project leadership.
Cost Awareness – Uses company resources responsibly and coordinates travel and project activities efficiently.
Store Readiness – Locations are left clean, organized, safe, operationally functional, and ready to serve customers following completion of the work.
Role Expectations
The Field Merchandiser is expected to take ownership of execution. The role requires individuals who are willing to roll up their sleeves and physically complete the work , while maintaining high standards for safety, accuracy, speed, organization, and store presentation.
The scope of the role extends beyond simply resetting shelves. Field Merchandisers may work across the sales floor, coolers, backrooms, storage areas, deli, sales desk, and other customer-facing merchandising areas to help create a more effective overall store.
The objective is not simply to complete a reset. The objective is to leave each location safer, easier to shop, easier to replenish, better organized, easier for the store team to operate, and fully aligned with the approved merchandising strategy.
